text:
sam: quick UX sync — thinking about the rules list density and preview placement. proposed: move the live preview into a bottom dock (sticky) instead of a modal so folks can scroll rules while seeing live results. quick takes?

 tess: bottom dock is useful for iteration, but vertical space is tight on laptops. can we make it collapsible and remember preference per user? :thinking_face: 

 leo: toggle sounds right. default to dock for >=1366px, modal for small screens. also suggest a compact row density option (condensed/comfortable).

 amira: copy nit: rule badge currently reads "Priority 1" — can we shorten? suggestions: "#1", "P1", or just the number with a visually-hidden label for screen readers. shorter helps scanning.

 sam: i like just the number visually and `aria-label="priority 1"` for SRs. keeps UI compact without losing semantics.

 tess: accessibility flag: the yellow warning chip contrast fails AA on 14px body text. will file an a11y ticket — prefer darker text or a subtle border.

 leo: keyboard reorder proposal: support Alt+ArrowUp / Alt+ArrowDown to move focused row. after move announce via aria-live: "Moved 'Reject risky billing' to 2 of 6". also set focus back to the moved row.

 amira: validation copy rewrite: replace vague "invalid" with "Condition format error — expected: attribute operator value (eg: country == 'US')" and include an inline monospaced example under the field. actionable and reduces support pings.

 sam: agree — add a small "See examples" link that expands a tiny helper with 3 examples instead of dumping long text. keeps inspector tidy.

 tess: preview microcopy: change "Preview (batch - 50)" to "Preview — sample 50" and show an estimated runtime badge like "≈ 2s". shorter and gives expectation.

 leo: if estimated runtime > 10s disable batch option with tooltip: "Large sample may time out; try a smaller sample". show specific error when preview times out: "Preview timed out — try sample 10 or check routing complexity" and link to troubleshooting doc.

 amira: pinned/system rules: instead of a heavy lock icon, show a subtle "system" badge and hide reorder affordances. on hover show tooltip: "Pinned by system policy — cannot reorder". less alarmist visually.

 sam: mobile fallback: no drag handle on mobile; enter a reorder mode on long press then show touch chevrons. tooltip: "Long-press to reorder". developers: we should persist mode only for that session.

 leo: small keyboard detail: when using keyboard reorder, announce the new ordinal and ensure screen reader sees a DOM change (update an offscreen aria-live region). avoid role=alert for everything, use polite for non-critical updates.

 tess: analytics events to add: layout_toggle (dock|modal), reorder_action (via_mouse|via_keyboard), reorder_undo, preview_run (sample_size), validation_help_clicked. helps measure adoption.

 amira: toast microcopy for reorder: proposal "Moved 'Reject risky billing' → #2  [Undo]". concise and the undo should be inline action.

 sam: agree. also ensure undo restores previous selection and focus.

 tess: inspector header text: current "Rules Inspector" is confusing for some PMs. suggest "Rule details" or "Rule editor"; show "(read-only)" suffix when user lacks edit perms. add a subtle lock icon only when read-only.

 leo: dev note: inspector width should be responsive; don't let helper text overflow, force wrap and increase z-index for helper popovers so they aren't clipped.

 amira: accessibility: when validation helper appears ensure it's reachable by keyboard (tab) and not just mouse hover. also prefer inline icons with text rather than color only.

 dev-bot: figma frames uploaded by tess: https://figma.redwood/frames/abc123 — review + comment by EOD. branch created: ui/ruleflow/layout-copy-sweep by tess. CI build 4910 started. :white_check_mark:

 sam: thanks — i'll compile action items and open tickets: density toggle, dock/modal toggle, keyboard reorder, toast copy change, preview microcopy & runtime badge, a11y contrast fix, pinned badge. aim for staging next week if no blockers.

 tess: i'll add the microcopy doc + screenshots to the figma frames. tagging ux-research for a quick sanity check on terminology. :sparkles: 

 leo: i'll write the keyboard interaction spec and a small test plan for screen readers tomorrow morning.

 amira: i'll file the a11y tickets and include color tokens.

 sam: perfect — appreciate the rapid checks.
